caption: Day 8. Mira Silt at the Fishstairs.
prompt: FULL-PAGE COLOUR INSERT ILLUSTRATION for a light novel, portrait orientation, edge-to-edge composition with a strong focal point and cinematic depth; opaque, fully painted background. The FISHSTAIRS of a frozen river: broad, worn stone steps descending to the edge of grey ice and black open water at a weir, wicker eel-traps stacked, salted perch hanging on lines, a low timber bridge crossing behind with a grey-coated figure on it, a pale winter sun. MIRA SILT (see reference: missing upper half of the left ear, eel slime on her sleeves, string of eel-bones, knotted cords at her waist) stands on the steps handing four eels to an off-frame buyer while looking sidelong at a WILLOW BASKET that SELLA VAIL (see reference) holds on her hip. The infant in the basket has a small BROWN-EDGED CRUST OF BARLEY BREAD tucked into the fold of grey wool beside him. Steam rises from the open water; gulls; the cold is almost visible.
